name: program-lean-stall
description: The program's lean screen, about 16 minutes a build on the ring: model behaviour on 64 prompts at 16 streams (it also heat-soaks the GPU; arms after the first score the first arm's text), the engine grid (the text-independent step cost at 1-16 requests), a closed loop at 8 streams and the single stream (each request a different prompt, thinking off), 240 s each after 60 s warm-up, and cold real-text prefill at 32K and 131K, three repeats. Built for experiments/2026-10-26-cluster-program; not a release suite. Then the concurrency-stalls suite's 131K stall probe (500-token probes 2-14 s into a cold 131K prefill beside 11 decoding streams, five repeats) before the prefill step. Built for experiments/2026-10-28-candidate-10-levers.
